fact: Car 40 (Equipment) unnecessarily impeded Car 20 in the pit lane.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 5 f) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed pit lane CCTV, pit stop position overhead cameras and timing. The competitor "double stacked" their cars to change tyres leaving car 40 sticking out into the transition lane and thereby unnecessarily impeded Car 20 for close to ten seconds. This is not permitted by the code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations

title: Infringement Car 40 Impeding Of Car 20
